$comment: Declares what the renderer emits and under what conditions. Inclusion is decided HERE rather than inside templates, so a template file stays valid HCL/YAML/Markdown on its own and factory CI can run `terraform fmt -check` and `terraform validate` against the raw corpus. Conditions use the same tiny expression grammar as the #{{IF}} directives: path, !path, defined path, path == 'v', path != 'v', path contains 'v', joined by && and ||. This manifest is the OUTPUT CONTRACT (docs/refactor/OUTPUT-CONTRACT.md): generation fails if a produced file is not listed here or a listed file is missing (validation gate V01). No generator machinery is ever listed.
$statusComment: Generator-only model (ADR 0013): the emitted Terraform is three root-module layers that reference Azure Verified Modules by pinned registry source+version. Nothing is vendored — the former `directories` module-copy mechanism is retired. Renovate keeps the pins current inside the generated repository with no dependency on this factory.
